result.description:
Temporary until 24th of December | $51.55p/h - $62.60p/h + Super | Melbourne, CBD/ Port Melbourne   Your new company     A large Victorian public sector organisation is seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Rostering Officer to support the delivery of a major statewide operational program. Working within a collaborative People Services team, you'll play a key role in coordinating workforce rosters, supporting payroll processes and ensuring staffing requirements are met during a high-profile and time-sensitive period.   Your new role     
 
 Coordinate and administer workforce rostering activities, including scheduling, roster maintenance and employee communications   
 Act as a key point of contact for employees and stakeholders regarding rostering and shift-related enquiries   
 Ensure rosters are prepared and maintained in accordance with organisational policies, procedures and compliance requirements   
 Maintain accurate employee records and workforce data to support effective rostering and reporting processes   
 Reconcile roster information against timesheets and support accurate payroll administration activities   
 Produce reports and workforce data analysis using rostering systems and Microsoft Excel   
 Work collaboratively with operational managers and internal stakeholders to support workforce planning outcomes   
 Contribute to a responsive, customer-focused People Services function during peak operational periods   
 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Demonstrated administration experience within Human Resources, workforce planning, scheduling, payroll or a similar operational environment   
 Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential information   
 Experience maintaining data integrity, records management and administrative processes   
 Strong systems capability, including experience using HR, payroll, workforce management or rostering systems   
 Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills, with the ability to generate reports and analyse workforce data   
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a strong customer service focus   
 Ability to prioritise competing tasks, work autonomously and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment   
 Exposure to public sector HR practices, enterprise agreements or workforce compliance requirements will be highly regarded   
 
   What you need to do now     
 If you're interested in applying, please submit your latest CV (in Word) to Lachlan.Knowles@hays.com.au. If this position isn't quite right for you, however you're still exploring new opportunities, please email your latest CV to start a conversation.  Please  click here  to apply.
